_comment: Region-specific pain points and personas (ids prefixed in_/eu_/us_). Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order, within the document's region).

categories.name: Illegal loan apps & morphed-photo harassment
categories.description: Instant-loan apps abusing contacts, morphing photos, charging huge fees.
keywords: loan app|instant loan|morphed|illegal (app|lender|loan)|chinese loan|fake loan|loan app harassment

categories.name: Recovery agents calling family & contacts
categories.description: Agents threatening, calling relatives, office and references.

categories.name: Processing fees & forced insurance
categories.description: Loan insurance bundled without consent, processing/foreclosure charges.

categories.name: Gold-loan renewals & auctions
categories.description: Gold loans auctioned, renewal rules, LTV changes.

categories.description: Slow sanction or disbursal, stalled builder projects with EMIs running.

categories.name: Personal loan rejections
categories.description: Rejected despite salary, unclear reasons, low CIBIL.

categories.name: Fixed-rate endings & remortgage shock

categories.name: Mortgage affordability rejections
categories.description: Declined on affordability, deposit size, self-employed income.
